item.title: Olivia Rodrigo’s New Album Has ‘Multiple Songs’ Inspired by Miranda and Steve from ‘Sex And The City
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news. Today, we're talking about Olivia Rodrigo's highly anticipated new album, "You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love".
[Soft music transitions in the background]
Host: In a recent appearance on The Tonight Show, Olivia spilled the beans about her forthcoming album, tour, and Saturday Night Live gig. She revealed that this record is all about romantic love, with a mix of happiness and a hint of sadness.
[Short sound clip of Olivia Rodrigo plays]
Host: Olivia mentioned that her favorite love songs, like "Love Song" by The Cure and "Video Games" by Lana Del Rey, have inspired her writing style. She also drew inspiration from her favorite TV show, Sex and the City, specifically the complex relationship between Miranda Hobbes and Steve Brady.
[Soft music continues]
Host: The album's lead single, "Drop Dead", debuted at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, marking her fourth song to top the chart. Olivia will perform "Drop Dead" and a brand new song on Saturday Night Live this weekend, where she'll be both host and musical guest.
[Short sound clip of Olivia Rodrigo plays]
Host: To support her new release, Olivia will embark on the Unraveled Tour, with 65 arena dates across North America, Europe, and the U.K. starting September 25th. We can't wait to hear her new songs live!
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you next time with more music news and updates.
